<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<title>AI4NEXT｜FINAL v36 · Commercial Terms × Team Structure</title>
<style>
:root{
  --black:#090a0c;
  --black2:#13161a;
  --paper:#eeece6;
  --paper2:#ddd9d1;
  --ink:#141619;
  --muted:#667079;
  --silver:#cfd3d5;
  --teal:#6f9fa1;
  --violet:#8b7ca6;
  --line-dark:rgba(20,22,25,.16);
  --line-light:rgba(255,255,255,.13);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--black);color:#efede7;font-family:Arial,"Noto Sans TC",sans-serif}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 68px));margin:auto}
nav{position:fixed;z-index:99;inset:0 0 auto;height:60px;background:rgba(9,10,12,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(15px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.navin{height:100%;width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 68px));margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.logo{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em}
.logo small{margin-left:12px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#798087}
.navlinks{display:flex;gap:18px}.navlinks a{font-size:10px;color:#8b9298}
.navlinks a:hover{color:#f2efe8}

section{padding:96px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.dark{background:var(--black)}
.dark2{background:var(--black2)}
.light{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
.light2{background:var(--paper2);color:var(--ink)}
.kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:800;color:#86aaac;margin-bottom:14px}
.light .kicker,.light2 .kicker{color:#4d7476}
.display{margin:0;font-size:clamp(58px,7.4vw,106px);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.07em;font-weight:900}
.section-title{margin:0;font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(38px,4.7vw,66px);line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.subhead{font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 12px}
.lead{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;color:#9da5ad;max-width:680px}
.light .lead,.light2 .lead{color:#56616a}
.body{font-size:14px;line-height:1.82;color:#929ba3}
.light .body,.light2 .body{color:#5c666f}
.caption{font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:#7d858c}
.light .caption,.light2 .caption{color:#6a737a}
.hair{height:1px;background:var(--line-light);margin:30px 0}
.light .hair,.light2 .hair{background:var(--line-dark)}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.06fr .94fr;gap:76px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:42px}

/* cover */
#cover{min-height:100vh;padding-top:92px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.cover-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center}
.cover-copy p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.75;color:#aab0b5;max-width:610px;margin-top:28px}
.cover-copy strong{color:#eeeae2}
.meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;margin-top:26px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#737b82}
.hero-object{height:590px;position:relative}
.hero-object .orbit{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:500px;height:310px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-12deg)}
.hero-object .orbit:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:15%;top:7%;width:10px;height:10px;border:1px solid #cbd0d2;border-radius:50%;background:#0e1013}
.hero-object .halo{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:330px;height:330px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(111,159,161,.16),rgba(139,124,166,.12) 34%,transparent 68%);filter:blur(12px)}
.hero-object svg{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:440px;height:440px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-8deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 35px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45))}
.obj-label{position:absolute;right:2%;top:20%;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#6d747b}
.obj-coord{position:absolute;right:2%;bottom:18%;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#5b6268}

/* why */
.problem-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.problem{padding:24px 22px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.problem:last-child{border-right:0}.problem small{font-size:10px;color:#4e7476;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em}.problem b{display:block;font-size:18px;line-height:1.25;margin:12px 0}.problem p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#5e6870;margin:0}

/* story */
.story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:26px}
.poster{min-height:600px;position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#08090b,#1d2227);overflow:hidden}
.poster:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.08;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.18) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.18) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:60px 60px}
.ring{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:50%}.rg1{width:420px;height:420px;right:-20px;top:75px}.rg2{width:270px;height:270px;right:55px;top:150px;border-color:rgba(111,159,161,.18)}.rg3{width:110px;height:110px;right:135px;top:235px}
.star{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#efede7}.st1{right:110px;top:170px}.st2{right:230px;top:330px}.st3{right:145px;top:445px}
.poster .big{position:absolute;left:28px;bottom:70px;font-size:clamp(62px,6.6vw,100px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.08em;font-weight:900}.poster .big span{color:#88aaac}
.poster .foot{position:absolute;left:30px;right:30px;bottom:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#777e85}
.story-copy{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding-top:18px}
.story-copy h3{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:31px;line-height:1.18;margin:12px 0 20px}
.story-copy p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;color:#9ca4ab}
.legend{margin-top:22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
.legend-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr;gap:14px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.legend-row b{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em}.legend-row span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#879098}
.story-path{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);margin-top:38px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.story-node{padding:18px 16px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);min-height:130px}.story-node:last-child{border-right:0}.story-node small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#82a6a8;font-weight:800}.story-node b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin:9px 0 6px}.story-node span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#7e8790}

/* OOPS identity */
.base-lock{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.base-name{padding:34px 30px 38px 0;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.base-name h3{margin:50px 0 22px;font-size:clamp(48px,5.2vw,78px);line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.065em}.base-name h3 span{color:#567d7f}.base-name p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.72;color:#5c656d;max-width:330px}
.base-system{padding:30px 0 32px 34px}
.lanes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.lane{padding:0 13px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.lane:first-child{padding-left:0}.lane:last-child{border-right:0}.lane small{font-size:9px;color:#4d7577;font-weight:800}.lane b{display:block;font-size:13px;margin:8px 0}.lane span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#687178}
.rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);margin-top:27px}.rail div{padding:0 10px;position:relative}.rail div:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:5px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#15181b}.rail b{display:block;font-size:10px}.rail span{font-size:10px;color:#757d84}

/* detailed ops */
.ops-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);margin-top:42px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.ops-item{padding:22px 20px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);min-height:190px}.ops-item:nth-child(3n){border-right:0}.ops-item small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#4e7779;font-weight:800}.ops-item b{display:block;font-size:16px;margin:9px 0 10px}.ops-item ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#626b73}
.timeline{margin-top:36px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:140px 1fr 1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.row>*{padding:12px 13px;border-left:1px solid var(--line-dark);font-size:11px;color:#5d666e}.row>*:first-child{border-left:0;color:#111317;font-weight:800}.row.head>*{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#4e7476;font-weight:800}

/* member journey */
.journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line-light);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light)}
.jstep{padding:20px 15px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);min-height:150px}.jstep:last-child{border-right:0}.jstep small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#82a6a8;font-weight:800}.jstep b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin:9px 0}.jstep span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#7f8991}
.member-engine{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:34px;margin-top:36px}.engine-note{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-top:18px}.engine-note h3{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-size:28px;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 14px}.engine-note p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#929ba3}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-top:17px}.tag{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:8px 11px;font-size:10px;color:#9ca4ab}
.drip{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}.drip-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:95px 1fr;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.drip-row b{font-size:11px}.drip-row span{font-size:12px;color:#8d969e}

/* partner */
.inputs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.input{padding:20px 16px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.input:first-child{padding-left:0}.input:last-child{border-right:0}.input small{font-size:9px;color:#4f7779;font-weight:800}.input b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0}.input span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#616a72}
.engine{margin:20px 0;padding:24px 26px;background:#111418;color:#efede7;display:grid;grid-template-columns:.36fr .64fr;align-items:center}.engine small{font-size:9px;color:#82a6a8;font-weight:800}.engine b{display:block;font-size:26px;margin-top:6px}.engine span{font-size:12px;color:#8e979f;line-height:1.6}
.pipe{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.pipe div{padding:13px 10px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);text-align:center}.pipe div:last-child{border-right:0}.pipe b{display:block;font-size:10px}.pipe span{font-size:9px;color:#687079}

/* commercial */
.commercial{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:70px}.commercial h3{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:31px;line-height:1.16;margin:10px 0 18px}.commercial p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.82;color:#5b646c}
.models{border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.model{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.model b{font-size:11px}.model span{font-size:12px;color:#606870;line-height:1.55}.model em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:#4e7678;margin-top:6px}
.biz-flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-top:34px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.biz-flow div{padding:18px 15px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.biz-flow div:last-child{border-right:0}.biz-flow b{display:block;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}.biz-flow span{font-size:11px;color:#606970}

/* october */
.mission{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1.3fr;border-top:1px solid var(--line-light);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light)}
.mcode{padding:36px 30px 40px 0;border-right:1px solid var(--line-light)}.mcode b{display:block;font-size:clamp(48px,5.4vw,80px);line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.065em}.mcode span{display:block;margin-top:19px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#747c83}
.mcopy{padding:34px 0 36px 34px}.mcopy h3{font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif TC",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:30px;line-height:1.18;margin:0 0 16px}.mcopy p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.82;color:#949da5}
.weeks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-top:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-light)}
.week{padding:20px 16px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}.week:last-child{border-right:0}.week small{font-size:9px;color:#82a6a8;font-weight:800}.week b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin:9px 0}.week ul{margin:0;padding-left:17px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65;color:#838d95}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);margin-top:28px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-light);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light)}
.kpi{padding:17px 11px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.kpi:last-child{border-right:0}.kpi b{display:block;font-size:20px}.kpi span{font-size:9px;color:#7f888f;line-height:1.4}

/* weekly */
.weekly{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.day{padding:20px 16px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);min-height:175px}.day:last-child{border-right:0}.day small{font-size:9px;color:#4f7779;font-weight:800}.day b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin:9px 0}.day span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#626b73}.day em{display:block;margin-top:12px;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:#4f7476}

/* role */
.retainer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .9fr .9fr;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.retainer>div{padding:18px 16px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.retainer>div:first-child{padding-left:0}.retainer>div:last-child{border-right:0}.retainer small{font-size:9px;color:#4f7779;font-weight:800}.retainer b{display:block;font-size:19px;margin:8px 0}.retainer span{font-size:11px;color:#5f6870}
.delivs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-top:30px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.deliv{padding:17px 15px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);min-height:135px}.deliv:nth-child(4n){border-right:0}.deliv small{font-size:9px;color:#4e7779;font-weight:800}.deliv b{display:block;font-size:13px;margin:8px 0}.deliv span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:#616970}
.metric-table{margin-top:34px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
.metric{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .75fr 1.55fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.metric>*{padding:11px 12px;border-left:1px solid var(--line-dark);font-size:11px;color:#5e676e}.metric>*:first-child{border-left:0;color:#111317;font-weight:800}.metric.head>*{font-size:9px;color:#4e7678;font-weight:800}

/* roadmap */
.road{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}.road>div{padding:24px 20px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);min-height:260px}.road>div:last-child{border-right:0}.road small{font-size:9px;color:#4e7779;font-weight:800}.road h3{font-size:19px;margin:12px 0}.road p,.road li{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#616970}
.future-note{margin-top:26px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark);padding-top:18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:180px 1fr;gap:20px}.future-note b{font-size:12px}.future-note span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#636c74}

/* final */
.final{min-height:60vh;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center}.final p{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#6e767d;margin-top:22px}

@media(max-width:980px){
  .split,.cover-grid,.story-grid,.base-lock,.member-engine,.commercial,.mission{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
  .hero-object{height:430px}
  .problem-grid,.story-path,.lanes,.ops-grid,.journey,.inputs,.pipe,.biz-flow,.weeks,.kpis,.weekly,.delivs,.road{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .base-name,.mcode{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
  .base-system,.mcopy{padding-left:0;padding-top:26px}
  .row{grid-template-columns:115px 1fr 1fr}.row>*:last-child{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .wrap,.navin{width:min(100% - 30px,1180px)}.navlinks{display:none}section{padding:76px 0}
  .display{font-size:52px}.section-title{font-size:38px}.hero-object{display:none}
  .problem-grid,.story-path,.lanes,.ops-grid,.journey,.inputs,.pipe,.biz-flow,.weeks,.kpis,.weekly,.delivs,.road{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .problem,.story-node,.lane,.ops-item,.jstep,.input,.pipe div,.biz-flow div,.week,.kpi,.day,.deliv,.road>div{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
  .dark .story-node,.dark .jstep,.dark .week,.dark .kpi{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
  .retainer{grid-template-columns:1fr}.retainer>div{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);padding-left:0}
  .metric{grid-template-columns:1fr}.metric>*{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
  .row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.row>*{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
  .future-note{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>

<style id="v24-readability">
/* V24 — readable editorial hierarchy */
:root{
  --text-dark:#303840;
  --text-mid:#505a63;
  --text-light:#b6bdc3;
  --text-light2:#9fa7ae;
}
.display{
  font-size:clamp(48px,6.2vw,88px)!important;
  line-height:.9!important;
  letter-spacing:-.055em!important;
}
.section-title{
  font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,54px)!important;
  line-height:1.11!important;
  letter-spacing:-.025em!important;
}
.subhead{font-size:22px!important;line-height:1.4!important}
.lead{
  font-size:16px!important;
  line-height:1.82!important;
  color:var(--text-light)!important;
}
.light .lead,.light2 .lead{color:#46515a!important}
.body{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.82!important;color:#aeb5bb!important}
.light .body,.light2 .body{color:#4d5861!important}
.caption{font-size:12px!important;line-height:1.6!important;color:#90989f!important}
.light .caption,.light2 .caption{color:#5a646d!important}
.kicker{font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.4!important}
.navlinks a{font-size:11px!important}
.logo small{font-size:9px!important}
.cover-copy p{font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.78!important}
.meta{font-size:11px!important}
.problem small,.lane small,.ops-item small,.jstep small,.input small,.week small,.day small,.deliv small,
.retainer small,.road small,.metric.head>*{font-size:10.5px!important}
.problem b{font-size:19px!important}
.problem p{font-size:14px!important;color:#515c65!important}
.story-copy p{font-size:15px!important;color:#aab1b7!important}
.legend-row b{font-size:12px!important}.legend-row span{font-size:13px!important;color:#969fa6!important}
.story-node small{font-size:10.5px!important}.story-node b{font-size:16px!important}.story-node span{font-size:13px!important;color:#8f989f!important}
.base-name p{font-size:14px!important;color:#4e5962!important}
.lane b{font-size:14px!important}.lane span{font-size:12px!important;color:#59636c!important}
.rail b{font-size:11px!important}.rail span{font-size:10.5px!important;color:#5f6870!important}
.ops-item b{font-size:17px!important}.ops-item ul{font-size:13px!important;color:#525d66!important}
.row>*{font-size:12px!important;color:#505b64!important}.row.head>*{font-size:10.5px!important}
.jstep b{font-size:15px!important}.jstep span{font-size:12.5px!important;color:#919aa2!important}
.engine-note p{font-size:14px!important;color:#aab2b9!important}.tag{font-size:11px!important}
.drip-row b{font-size:12px!important}.drip-row span{font-size:13px!important;color:#9ca5ac!important}
.input b{font-size:15px!important}.input span{font-size:12.5px!important;color:#535e67!important}
.engine small{font-size:10px!important}.engine span{font-size:13px!important}
